title: Patches & Governance | ContextMint Docs
description: Assisted actions, patch preview gate 2, quality map, DRY governance, and audit-friendly telemetry.
lead: ContextMint enforces human gates: evidence before inference (Context Lens), diffs before apply (patch preview). Governance signals inform — and optionally gate — high-risk changes.

gate1.title: Gate 1 — Context Lens
gate1.after: You approve retrieved context before the model answers.

gate2.title: Gate 2 — Patch preview
gate2.intro: In Agent mode, proposed edits appear as a unified diff:
items: Accept applies to workspace (or sandbox worktree when enabled)
Reject discards the proposal — no silent writes

assisted.title: Assisted actions
assisted.text: Structured action cards (refactors, test scaffolding, etc.) include risk level and reasoning references. Confirm or cancel explicitly; telemetry mirrors audit metadata (no file contents in telemetry POST).

qualityMap.title: Quality map
qualityMap.text: Engine → Quality runs scans for clones, near-duplicates, and structure signals. Findings appear in the governance drawer during Context Lens. In Repo lane, governed chat may apply DRY shortcuts when high-confidence duplicate patterns match your question.

scope.title: Governed chat scope
scope.text: Quality-map shortcuts apply in Repo context lane only. Work and Hybrid lanes use standard assembly without governed duplicate routing.

argus.title: ARGUS findings → patch preview
argus.before: ARGUS visual audit returns structured UI findings — it does not modify your repo. If you choose to fix an issue, ContextMint can hand off to an assisted action and the same patch preview flow (gate 2). You still review unified diffs before apply. See

audit.title: Audit & telemetry
items: Server writes audit JSONL per workspace (chat streams, actions, indexing events) under ~/.contextmint/audit/ — persisted on disk; Engine Knowledge → Activity only displays a configurable time window (default 1 h, max 24 h in UI)

items.before: Engine Knowledge tab — verify structural registries and export activity audit for governance reviews —

enterprise.title: Enterprise posture
enterprise.before: Regulated teams pair local-first defaults with shared on-prem API, OIDC, and BYOK cloud routing. See
